description: Hotel visitors in San Francisco: how they travel from their hotels, how many there are, and how many ride Muni. Gathered October 2026 to replace the assumed visitor mode shares (27% transit). Numbers are copied from the named source unless labeled derived.

hotelDoorSurvey.source: SF Planning, Transportation Impact Analysis Guidelines for Environmental Review (October 2019), Appendix F: Travel Demand, Figure 1 (hotel panel, PDF p.7) and Table 1 (p.4); detailed shares from the SFCTA travel demand tool's API, https://api.sfcta.org/api/tia_modesplit (landuse 'Hotel').
hotelDoorSurvey.method: Door intercept surveys at 11 hotel sites, spring 2017, weekdays 3-7 pm (Appendix F footnote 4). Person trips into and out of the hotel; respondents include employees and other visitors to the hotel as well as guests. Private shuttles are counted as observed but left out of the department's impact analysis.

tripsPerRoom.note: person trips per hotel room per weekday, all trip makers (Table 1, p.4)

placeTypeOfNeighborhood.note: Appendix F Figure 2 maps three place types by planning district: urban high density (1) Downtown/North Beach, SoMa, and Mission; urban medium density (2) Marina/Western Market and Richmond; urban low density (3) Sunset, Outer Mission/Hills, and Bayshore. Each Analysis Neighborhood is assigned here to the district that holds most of it (our reading of the map).

occupancy.source: SF Travel press release, May 7, 2026 (2025 results: 67.2%) and August 26, 2026 (2026 forecast: 70.7%); 2024 derived from the March 20, 2025 release's RevPAR $143.25 / ADR $227.51.

rooms.note: secondary press figure (c. 2015); SF Travel's 2011 fact sheet gave 32,976. No official 2024-2026 count was retrievable (the 2024 lodging statistics PDF is behind Cloudflare).

partySize.source: SF-CHAMP visitor model (sfchampdocs), persons per party

overnightVisitors2025.source: SF Travel and Tourism Economics, San Francisco Visitor Volume and Direct Spending Estimates 2025, p.3; overnight includes stays with friends and in rentals

snapshotOutsideBayArea.note: MTC 2023-24 Snapshot (od-validation.json): riders whose home ZIP is in the US outside the nine counties; riders living abroad or giving no ZIP are left out of the shares; cable cars and historic streetcars are surveyed as 'Local Bus' (MTC transit-passenger-surveys, preprocessing_RegionalSnapshot_2023.py).

onboard2017VisitorFareMedia.source: SFMTA 2025 Title VI Program Update, Appendices (MTAB November 4, 2025, item 12), FY25-26 fare-change equity analysis from the 2017 Muni Onboard Survey, PDF pp.275-281; 88% of Passport and CityPass users said they were visitors. A lower bound on visitors (cash and Clipper visitors not counted).

cableCarWeekday2024.source: NTD 2024 service data, SFMTA mode CC (ntd-trip-length.json)
